query:
SELECT
                    ch.category_id,
                    h.id,
                    h.label,
                    h.usage_count,
                    h.created_at as "created_at: DateTime<Utc>"
                FROM category_hint ch
                JOIN hint h ON h.id = ch.hint_id
                WHERE ch.user_id = $1
                ORDER BY ch.category_id, h.label ASC
